rdfs:label: dateCopyrighted
rdfs:comment: The date of a statement of copyright over the resource.
notes: The copyright year, distinct from `urn:solid:created` (when the work was made) and `urn:solid:issued` (when published). Often the same year as creation but can differ for posthumous publication or transferred rights. ISO 8601 value: an xsd:date, or (most commonly) an xsd:gYear for a copyright year. Sub-property of `urn:solid:date`.

history.note: Dropped xsd:date range (gYear is common); example uses a typed xsd:gYear; seeAlso/notes now reference urn:solid:created and urn:solid:issued.
